## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes locally
- [ ] `make lint` is clean (ran `make format` if needed)
- [ ] Docs updated in the same change if behavior, a builtin, a flag, or a config
      var changed (see the docs sync map in `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] Commits are focused — one logical change each (no unrelated churn)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, or `.sessions/` contents committed
